newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Goodwill buys HK$118 mln Peak property.
newsitem.headline: Goodwill buys HK$118 mln Peak property.

text.p: Financial services and property investment group Goodwill Investment (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday its 90 percent owned Orient World Investment Ltd has agreed to buy a property on the Peak for HK$118 million.

Orient World, 10 percent owned by Goodwill chairman Fung Ka Pun, has agreed to buy the property covering a site area of 10,000 square feet at Lugard Road in Hong Kong island's prestigious Peak district from an unidentified independent third party, the statement said.
Goodwill said it would fund the purchase through internal resources and bank borrowings. The property will be held for investment purposes, it added.
